name: VBO Media Export
description: Adds a Views Bulk Operations action to bulk-download media entities as a ZIP file.
project_description:
VBO Media Export is a contrib Drupal module that integrates with the Views Bulk Operations (VBO) module to allow users to download selected media entities as a ZIP archive. It supports bulk operations to export media from various media types with custom field configurations.

 Features 
 
 Allows the bulk download of media entities as a ZIP file. 
 Configurable to select media types and corresponding field machine names. 
 Displays success or error messages for processed files. 
 Provides a download link for the generated ZIP file. 
 Handles failed file paths and provides clickable links to media entity pages for review. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Views Bulk Operations (VBO) module installed and enabled.
